title: Falling is the easy part
text:
Skydiving
Tandem skydiving in Thailand and India
Falling is the easy part
A tandem jump asks nothing of you. You arrive, you sign a form, you spend twenty minutes with the instructor strapped to your back learning one body position, and then you are at 13,000 feet with the door open. Freefall lasts about forty-five seconds. Under canopy it is another five minutes, quiet, with the view opening beneath you.
Choose Pattaya for a tandem over the Gulf of Thailand, or Mount Abu for a tandem in Rajasthan, India.
Where to start with skydiving
About 3 hours at the dropzone · Pattaya Dropzone, Thailand
Sea View Skydiving — Tandem Jump over Pattaya
The straightforward first jump. Same aircraft, same instructors, same sea view — no cameras, no extras.
Handycam or outside camera · Mount Abu, India
Tandem Skydive — Mount Abu, Rajasthan
A tandem skydive in India, filmed on a handycam or by an outside cameraman.
Where you can do it
Pattaya Dropzone
Pattaya, Thailand
Mount Abu
Mount Abu, Rajasthan, India
What you are wearing
All of it is provided and all of it is checked twice before you board — once by the instructor who packed it and once by the instructor jumping with you.
Main and reserve
Two parachutes, always. The reserve is packed and certified by a rigger, and an automatic activation device will deploy it for you if it ever needs to.
Harness and container
The tandem harness attaches at four points and is tightened by the instructor before you walk to the aircraft, then again in it.
Altimeter
Worn on the wrist. On a tandem the instructor flies the jump, but you will be shown how to read it.
Camera, if you want one
Shot by a second jumper flying alongside you, not on a stick. Added to the Deluxe and VIP packages.
Ready when you are
Booking requests are pending until we confirm them. Message us and we will tell you what is open.

Before you message
Do I need any experience to do a tandem jump?
None at all. On a tandem you are harnessed to a USPA-certified instructor who handles the exit, the freefall and the landing. You get a full briefing on the ground first — around 20 minutes — and that is all the preparation you need.
What are the age and weight limits?
You must be 18 or older with valid ID. The weight limit is 100 kg for tandem jumps, and we ask that your weight is proportional to your height for harness fit. If you are close to the limit, message us before booking and we will confirm.
Do I have to pay in advance?
No. Send us your preferred date on WhatsApp and we will hold your slot. You pay at the dropzone on the day of the jump.
What happens if the weather is bad?
Jumps run on wind and cloud conditions, not the clock. If a load is held, you wait for the next window the same day, or we move you to another date at no cost. We never jump in unsafe conditions.
How long does the whole thing take?
Budget three to four hours at the dropzone. That covers check-in, the safety briefing, gear fitting, the flight to altitude, the jump itself, and collecting your video and photos afterwards.

title: Cancellations
text:
Plan with care
Cancellations
Cancellations
Weather, changes of plan, and what happens to your money.
The short version
If the weather stops you jumping, you do not lose your money — you move to the next window or another date, at no cost.
If you cancel, what happens depends on how much notice you give and whether the operator has already committed a seat or an instructor to you.
If you do not turn up, the slot is gone.
If the weather stops the activity
Skydiving, paragliding and snowboarding all run only in safe conditions, and the person on the ground decides what is safe. Diving is called on sea state and visibility.
If your load, flight or dive is held for weather you can wait for the next window the same day at no cost, move to any other date at no cost, or take a full refund of anything you have paid.
There is no charge and no admin fee for a weather move. It is the most common reason an activity does not run and it is nobody's fault.
If the activity is stopped part-way
If an aircraft turns back, a dive is aborted or a lift closes after you have started, the operator will either re-run the activity when conditions allow or refund the portion you did not receive.
On a multi-dive or multi-jump package, days already completed are not refunded — the days you did not get are.
If you cancel
Single-day activities — a tandem jump, a tandem flight, a discover-scuba day, a snowboard day. Cancel with more than 48 hours' notice and there is nothing to pay. Inside 48 hours the operator may have committed an instructor and a seat to you, so a charge may apply; we will tell you what it is before you confirm anything.
Courses. Cancel more than 7 days before the start date and any deposit is refunded in full. Inside 7 days the deposit may be held against the instructor time already reserved. Once a course has started it is not refundable, because the instructor is committed for its whole length — but it can usually be paused and resumed within the same season.
Multi-day trips and camps. These have fixed departure dates, flights and accommodation booked against them, and the terms are stricter. They are stated on each trip's own page and they are the terms that apply.
To cancel, message us on WhatsApp. A cancellation is effective when we acknowledge it, not when it is sent.
If you do not turn up
A no-show is treated as a same-day cancellation and the slot is not refunded. If something has genuinely gone wrong on the way, tell us as early as you can — we would much rather move you than lose you.
If we or the operator cancel
If we cancel for any reason other than weather or safety — a schedule change, an aircraft out of service, a course that does not fill — you choose between a full refund and an alternative date. Where the alternative costs more, we cover the difference.
We will never quietly move you onto a different package. Any change is offered, not applied.
How refunds are paid
Because payment is taken by the operator on the day, most cancellations involve nothing to refund — there is simply nothing to pay.
Where a deposit has been paid, it is returned by the same method it was sent, normally within 7 working days of the cancellation being confirmed. Any bank or transfer fee charged by your own bank is outside our control.
Travel insurance
We strongly recommend insurance that explicitly covers the activity you are booking. Many standard travel policies exclude skydiving, freefall and diving below a certain depth, and a policy that excludes the thing you came to do is not cover.
This policy governs what we and the operator refund. It cannot cover your flights, your accommodation or your time.

title: Terms and conditions
text:
The details
Terms and conditions
Terms and conditions
What you are agreeing to when you book, in plain language.
Who you are booking with
Greedy Adventures arranges adventure activities with the operators who run them — the dropzones that fly the aircraft, the schools that certify the divers, the pilots who fly the tandems. We are the booking and the point of contact; the activity itself is delivered by the operator named on the package page.
This matters in one practical way: the operator's own safety rules, weight limits and medical requirements apply on the day, and they are final. Where we know them, they are written on the package page.
Booking and payment
Slots are held on request. There is no cart and no payment gateway on this website, and no card details are ever entered here.
You pay the operator directly at the dropzone, dive shop or mountain on the day, unless the package page says otherwise. Multi-day trips and courses with fixed departure dates may ask for a deposit to hold a place; if so it is stated on that trip's page and agreed in writing before anything is taken.
Prices are shown in the currency they are quoted in — Thai baht for Thailand, Indian rupees for India — and are not converted. What you see is what the operator charges.
Requirements
You must be 18 or older to make a tandem skydive, and you must bring valid photo identification. Some activities accept younger participants with a guardian present: paragliding from 16, scuba from 10 on junior courses, snowboard group lessons from 12.
Tandem skydives carry a 100 kg weight limit. It is a limit of the harness and the canopy, not a judgement, and it cannot be waived.
You must declare any heart condition, respiratory condition, recent surgery, pregnancy, or anything you take regular medication for. Scuba requires a medical questionnaire and, for some answers, a doctor's sign-off before you can be certified.
Nobody under the influence of alcohol or drugs will be permitted to take part. This is not negotiable and no refund is given in that situation.
Safety and the operator's discretion
Every activity we sell is weather-dependent and condition-dependent. The instructor, pilot or divemaster on the day has absolute discretion to delay, shorten or stop an activity, and to decline a participant, on safety grounds.
If that happens you are not being penalised, and the cancellations page sets out exactly what you get back.
Photos and video
Photo and video packages are shot by the operator. Where a package includes media, it is normally handed over the same day; if equipment fails and no usable footage exists, that portion of the price is refunded.
We sometimes ask whether we can use a photograph of your jump on this site or on Instagram. We ask first, every time, and no is a complete answer with no effect on your booking.
Complaints and liability
If something goes wrong, tell us. The fastest route is WhatsApp on the number in the footer, and we will take it up with the operator on your behalf.
Adventure sports carry inherent risk that cannot be removed by any amount of training or equipment. You will be asked to sign the operator's own waiver on the day, and you should read it. Nothing on this page limits any right you have that cannot be limited by law.
Changes to these terms
These terms apply from the date shown at the foot of the page. If they change, the version in force is the one published when you booked.

title: Privacy
text:
Privacy
Privacy
Privacy
What we collect, why, and how to have it removed.
The short version
We collect what you send us in order to arrange your activity, and nothing else. We do not sell it, we do not share it for marketing, and we do not run advertising trackers on this site.
There are no accounts on this website, so there is nothing to log in to and no profile stored against you.
What we collect, and when
When you message us on WhatsApp: your phone number, your name as it appears on WhatsApp, and whatever you write. This is how most bookings happen.
When you use the contact form: your name, WhatsApp number, trip preferences, and your message.
When you subscribe to the newsletter: your email address, and nothing else.
When you book: the details the operator needs on the day — usually name, age, weight for tandem activities, and any medical information you have declared. Medical information is given to the operator running your activity and to nobody else.
We do not ask for and never store card details. There is no payment gateway on this site.
What we do with it
We use your details to answer your question, arrange your booking, and tell you if something about it changes.
We pass to the operator only what they need to run your activity safely and to have you on the manifest.
If you subscribe to the newsletter we send occasional email about season dates, course openings and trips. Every one of those has an unsubscribe link and one click is enough.
Who else can see it
The operator running your activity — the dropzone, the dive school, the flying site — receives your booking details. They are named on the package page before you book.
This site is hosted by Vercel, which processes standard server logs including IP addresses.
Conversations you start on WhatsApp are carried by WhatsApp and subject to their privacy policy as well as this one.
The About page embeds reels from Instagram. Those are loaded by Instagram in a frame, and Instagram may set cookies and see that a browser requested them. We receive nothing from those embeds.
That is the complete list. We do not use Google Analytics, advertising pixels, or third-party trackers.
How long we keep it
Booking correspondence is kept for 24 months after the activity, because questions about a jump, a certification or an insurance claim tend to arrive long after the day itself.
Newsletter subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe.
Medical declarations are kept by the operator under their own retention rules, not by us.
Your rights
You can ask us what we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted. Message us on WhatsApp or email the address in the footer and we will action it within 30 days.
Deletion is straightforward, with one exception: where we are required to retain a record for insurance or safety reasons, we will say so and tell you when it can be removed.
You can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time without affecting anything else.
Cookies
This site sets no advertising or analytics cookies of its own.
Instagram embeds on the About page and any embedded video may set their own cookies when they load. Blocking third-party cookies in your browser will stop those and the rest of the site will work normally.
Children
Some activities accept participants under 18 with a guardian. In those cases we deal with the guardian, and the details we collect about a minor are limited to what the operator needs for safety on the day.
Getting in touch
Anything about your data — a question, a correction, or a deletion request — goes to the WhatsApp number in the footer of this page. A real person reads it.
